title: secp256k1-ecdlp: Pollard's rho with Floyd cycle detection (rho-v3)

claims.statement: For uniform x in [0,r), input Q=[x]P on secp256k1, Pollard's rho using Floyd cycle detection (tortoise and hare) recovers x with success probability at least 0.39. Two independent trials are run, each with a hard cap of 2^{130.5} reference operations; the total charged work of both trials is at most 2^{130.5}. Peak memory is O(1) (≤ 2^{16} bytes). No distinguished-point table and no negation map are used. Heuristics are disclosed in proof.md. This is a classical cold attack with no uncharged advice.

experiments.purpose: Demonstrate Floyd cycle detection and discrete-log recovery on a small cyclic additive group. Confirms control flow only.
